claim_text: An accessory dwelling unit in the Cedar Lane district may be built to a height of 24 feet.
regulation_text: Section 6.7 — Accessory Dwelling Units. An accessory dwelling unit shall comply with the maximum building height applicable to the principal dwelling in the underlying district. This section does not establish a separate height limit for accessory dwelling units.
